meta.name: LetsHyre Pricing
meta.schemaDescription: Credit plans for unlocking AI-interviewed candidates on LetsHyre, from a free starter plan to custom plans for large teams.

hero.title: Pay only for the candidates you unlock.
hero.body: Credits unlock candidates who have already finished a LetsHyre AI interview. You buy them once, there's no monthly bill, and they don't expire.

plans.heading: Plans
plans.note: Prices are in Indian rupees and don't include GST, which is added at checkout.
plans.rate: Every credit costs {{price}}, whichever plan you choose.

free.name: Free
free.audience: Try it on a real role

pro.name: Pro
pro.audience: For teams that hire now and then

compare.title: Compare plans
compare.body: Every plan unlocks the same candidate information. What changes is how many credits you get, who on your team can see results, and the support you get.
compare.caption: What each plan includes

topUps.title: Need more credits?
topUps.body: On Pro or Business you can top up at any time. Top-up credits never expire, just like the ones in your plan.

items.q: What does a credit get me?
items.a: Credits unlock candidates who have finished a LetsHyre AI interview. An unlocked candidate shows you their full profile, resume, AI scorecard and interview recording. You'll see how many credits an unlock needs before you confirm it.
No. Credits stay in your account until you use them, whether they came with your plan or from a top-up.
No. Every purchase is a one-time payment. Nothing renews and you're never charged automatically.

items.q: Who on my team can see results?
items.a: Free lets you share results with 1 teammate, Pro with 5 and Business with 25. If you need more seats than that, a custom plan covers any team size.
Payments go through Razorpay, so you can use UPI, a card or net banking. Prices are in Indian rupees, and any applicable tax is shown at checkout before you pay.

We review refund requests made within 7 days for duplicate payments, billing errors, or a platform problem that stopped you getting what you paid for. Profiles you've already unlocked can't be refunded. The <refund>refund policy</refund> has the full details.
